title: Even so
titleZh: 「Even so」表示「即使如此／儘管如此」
titleEn: Using Even so to express a result that still holds

source.file: Sentence Structure 165 -「Even so」表示「即使如此／儘管如此」.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Statement A. Even so, Statement B

formulas.formula: Statement A. Even so, Statement B

example: The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.
exampleZh: 市場並不穩定。即使如此，一些投資者仍保持信心。

examples.en: The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.
examples.zh: 市場並不穩定。即使如此，一些投資者仍保持信心。
examples.highlight: The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.

rules.zh: Even so 承接前面整個意思 Even so 是承接前面整個意思，而不是只修飾其中一個字。
rules.en: Even so refers back to the whole preceding idea, not merely to one word in the previous sentence.
examples: Even so refers back to the whole idea in the previous sentence.

rules.zh: 注意標點 在本練習中，Even so 前面使用句號，後面使用逗號。
rules.en: Use the punctuation required in this exercise: put a full stop before Even so and a comma after it, as in The task was difficult. Even so, we completed it.
examples: In this exercise, place a full stop before Even so and a comma after it.
The task was difficult. Even so, we completed it.
The task was difficult even so we completed it.

rules.zh: 前後都必須是完整句子 Even so 前後兩部分都必須是完整句子。
rules.en: Both the part before Even so and the part after it must be complete sentences.

rules.zh: 必須有「儘管如此，仍然……」的意思 只有當第二個意思出乎意料，或在第一個情況下仍然成立時，才使用 even so。
rules.en: Use Even so only when the meaning is “despite that, this still happens”. The second idea must be unexpected or remain true despite the first situation.

rules.zh: Even though 與 Even so 的句式不同 Even though 後面直接接子句；even so 則承接前面已經完成的句子。
rules.en: Even though and Even so use different structures. Even though is followed directly by a clause: Even though the market was unstable, some investors remained confident. Even so refers back to an already complete sentence: The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.
examples: Even though + subject + verb, main clause
Even though the market was unstable, some investors remained confident.
The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.

benefits.zh: 它能清楚顯示反差 讀者可以立即明白：即使有前面的困難，後面的結果仍然發生。
benefits.en: It makes the contrast clear The reader can immediately understand that the second result happened despite the first difficulty.

benefits.zh: 它能自然連接兩個完整意思 你不需要把兩句話分開而不說明關係；even so 能清楚指出兩者之間的讓步關係。
benefits.en: It connects two complete ideas naturally Instead of leaving two short sentences unrelated, even so clearly shows how they are connected.

benefits.zh: 它能加強第二個意思 把 even so 放在主要結果前，可以突出「事情仍然發生」或「情況仍然成立」。
benefits.en: It gives the second idea more emphasis Placing even so before the main result draws attention to what still happened or remained true.

benefits.zh: 它能避免重複使用 but 和 however 在說話、作文、報告和簡報中，你可以用另一種自然方式表達轉折。
benefits.en: It helps you avoid repeating but and however You gain another natural way to express contrast in speaking, essays, reports and presentations.

benefits.zh: 它提供一個容易使用的說話框架 你可以先說明困難，稍作停頓，再用 Even so, ... 說出仍然成立的重點。 第二個版本把困難和出乎意料的結果分開呈現，因此後面的重點更加突出。
benefits.en: It provides a useful speaking frame You can first mention a difficulty, pause, and then continue with Even so, ... Compare The market was unstable, but some investors remained confident. The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.
examples: You can first mention a difficulty, pause, and then continue with Even so, ...
The market was unstable, but some investors remained confident.
The market was unstable. Even so, some investors remained confident.
